name: adjutant-voice-notify
description: Speaks one sentence in a synthetic command-computer voice when a task, a long terminal command or a Claude Code turn finishes. Unofficial fan tool.

commands.title: Adjutant Voice: Install Claude Code Hook
Adjutant Voice: Remove Claude Code Hook

adjutantVoice.tasks.description: Announce when a VS Code task finishes.

adjutantVoice.terminalCommands.description: Announce when a long terminal command finishes (needs terminal shell integration).

adjutantVoice.minimumSeconds.description: Only work that took at least this long is announced: tasks, terminal commands and Claude Code turns alike. 0 announces everything.

adjutantVoice.ignoreCommands.description: Programs whose end is not announced (interactive ones, mostly). Matched against the first word of the command.

adjutantVoice.claude.description: Announce when Claude Code finishes a turn (needs the Claude Code hook; see the Install command).

adjutantVoice.rephrase.description: Reword each notification before speaking so it is easier to make out through the voice effect. Sends the notification text to Claude through Claude Code and adds a few seconds.

adjutantVoice.rephraseModel.description: The Claude model used for rewording.

adjutantVoice.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code program used for rewording. Empty looks for "claude".

adjutantVoice.voiceLink.description: A link from the Adjutant Online page carrying voice settings. Empty uses the default voice.

adjutantVoice.cliPath.description: Path to the speaker program (dist-cli/say.js). Empty uses the path recorded when the extension was built.

adjutantVoice.nodePath.description: The Node.js program used to run the speaker.
